geeklist.title: BGG.Spring 2024 Virtual Flea Market (VFM)
geeklist.description:
[size=24]This list is closed![/size]
Hello All! It's time for the the BGG.Spring 2024 Virtual Flea Market (VFM)! I will be hosting this event once again.
You must be an attendee (or have a proxy attendee) of BGG Con Spring 2024 to pick up and exchange items at this event.
[b]If you are new to the VFM or unsure of something please, please read the general information posted as Item number 1 in this geek list. [/b]
It should hopefully answer any questions and if not comment on the item and people will gladly help.
[u][b]Main information[/b][/u] Where: Innovation Ballroom When: Friday May 24th 8pm (My birthday! :D) Sellers: 7pm -7:50 [b]ALL SELLERS MUST BE INSIDE NO LATER THAN 7:50pm.[/b] Buyers: 8pm - 9pm
[u][b]Table assignment information[/b][/u] [imageid=8218799 original]
[b]REMEMBER DO NOT DELETE YOUR LISTINGS[/b]
[b][u]Links[/u][/b] [geeklist=331338]BGG Spring 2024 VFM Request List[/geeklist] [url=https://www.yulgame.com/Vfm/AddItems/331341]Bulk add games to the geeklist[/url] * This is an easy way to bulk add items to the geeklist, courtesy of Eric Bettan (Carnage994): [url=https://www.yulgame.com/Vfm/Items/331341]BGG Spring VFM 2024 sortable list[/url] [url=https://sunderedrealm.com/bgg/bgg-list.php?l=331341]Alternate BGG Spring VFM 2024 sortable list[/url] Provided by Dave Rathbun
[b]Note[/b]: the sortable list does make use of the MARK SOLD Button Below your item's picture

Hi, folks, as games start to sell, a quick reminder - for people that use the various list aggregator tools, there are two reliable ways to mark your games sold so they no longer show up as actively available. Either use the "Mark Sold" button under the image for your listing, or add the tag [c]+sold+[/c] to your listing. Using the bare word "sold" is problematic because it can be taken out of context. Also if you want to remove an item, the tag is [c]+remove+[/c]. That will mark the item as removed without counting it as sold.
Thanks!

[q="MonkeyMooDad"]Could anyone please tell me how to add a link in the post itself? I’d like to add links to expansions that are included. Thank you![/q]
While editing the post, use the Add Link button on the Write tab. In the Add a Link popup, click in the Search field and by default it will be set to Board Game. Just type the name of the board game or expansion and select it when found. Then just click the Add Link button and a link to the board game or expansion will be inserted where your cursor was.

When we are super close to the end of this. If anyone has titles that they have not sold that are family friendly and not overly complex, would you consider sending my way to donate? I am donating to my local library as I have just gotten them started with a board game section. I pulled a few of mine to take up there today. Choice is yours, but hope to add a few when I return from con. Happy gaming y’all. 😁

[q="Barkerware"]When we are super close to the end of this. If anyone has titles that they have not sold that are family friendly and not overly complex, would you consider sending my way to donate? I am donating to my local library as I have just gotten them started with a board game section. I pulled a few of mine to take up there today. Choice is yours, but hope to add a few when I return from con. Happy gaming y’all. 😁[/q] And if necessary I can provide confirm receipt from library when they receive anything donated. 😁

That is a great idea for donating to the library! My local Flower Mound Public Library has seen their collection grow from 10 games to 50 in the last year. It is awesome to see. I checked out "Trekking Through History" just yesterday.
My only advice is to make sure we are donating "good" games to the library. If we want more people to appreciate modern board games we have to show them games that make this hobby great. Many people have a negative stigma from board games from playing so many terrible mass market games over the years. I hate noticing that someone might check out the game on the shelf that is rated 4.0 on BGG. They check it out, play it, are bored, don't play again, and don't check out another game. (in my opinion: most of the free games we have received at BGG.con would be bad games to give to a library. I would rather see those games recycled than on the shelves at my library where they only have so much room.)

Hey all, I made a React app that allows you to sort and filter items by average rating, among other things. I'm still working on it so it's not perfect, but give it a shot: [url=https://bgg.honormountain.co/]https://bgg.honormountain.co/[/url]
The page loads with this geeklist id prepopulated for now. Hit the load button, it takes about a minute to load all the items. Clicking the column header will sort. The icon button at the right side of the column will allow you to filter. If you click the button in the 'Details' column it will load the listing description and comments so you can quickly see if it's sold or what the current bid is. The sold column is not nearly accurate because it depends on text in the description, so use the 'Details' button to check listings before getting too excited about what you see in the table. Also, the table is not showing up on mobile for some reason, still working on that... so use a desktop browser.
Enjoy and let me know if you have any feedback!

One of the great things about the VFM every year is when I ask my wife about selling a game we haven’t played in a while and she recommends playing it, “one more time,” just to make sure. Sometimes, that results in a game getting back into circulation. Other times, we enjoy a final play but decide to move on and make room for something else. Either way, it’s a win. Last night, we played [thing=137297][/thing] and decided to keep it. We probably hadn’t played it in 10 years. Now we have plans to teach it to some friends. I look forward to the VFM each year for many reasons. Creating excuses to play long-neglected games with my wife is certainly one of them.
And here I thought I had too many trick taking games. [user=Aaronw92][/user] are you trying to clean out a closet full? That’s an impressive display.
I know, right? If the items were posted to PGC discord, most would sell out in a matter of seconds.

Do they host their own trick taking convention? That could be fun time.

Yes. Here’s the information:
**__Location__** Milwaukie Community Club - 10666 SE 42nd Ave, Milwaukie, OR 97222
**__Date__** July 20th and 21st, 2024
**__Tickets__** <https://portlandgamecollective.bigcartel.com/product/2024-pgc-convention-ticket>
**__Other Important Info__** The seating is cafeteria-style. Think benches and folding chairs. Bring a cushion, blanket, hoodie, etc. Whatever makes you feel comfortable. As for the weather, it was in the mid-90s to 100s the first year and teeny bit cooler last year and it wasn't terrible! Will you be chilly? No. But you shouldn't be sweltering either.
There is a kitchen available to us, so you can bring food and drink and keep it in the refrigerator. Anything left at the end of the day on Sunday, 7/21, will be tossed. I put in some more work on my geeklist utility. Check it out, you may find some deals you may have missed otherwise: https://bgg.honormountain.co/
A few great features that I feel differentiate it from other tools: - You can sort and filter by price (ex. Games $10 and below) - You can sort and filter by rating (ex. Games rated 6 and above) - You can sort and filter by list date (ex. Games listed since May 10th) - You can filter by whether it's an expansion or not - You can filter by whether it's been sold or not (this is determined by if the seller has marked it as sold OR wrote it's sold in the description) - Any combination of the above!
Plus, you can quickly check comments and average price paid in the marketplace without leaving the utility ("Check Listing" button)! AND, you can filter by user wishlist!
Give it a try and let me know if you have any questions or feedback!

IMPORTANT! Always do a quick double check for accuracy, the prices are detected by a machine and may be lower than what you're asking for if you included another $ reference in you item description. item.body:
[b][size=24]BASIC INFORMATION AND RULES[/size][/b]
[u][b][size=18]Event Tickets[/size][/b][/u]
There is no longer a TTE ticket requirement for this event.
Buyers/Sellers can claim at ticket on TTE to help them remember the place and time but it is not required.
[size=18][u][b]General[/b][/u][/size]
The primary purpose of the Virtual Flea Market is to arrange the selling of games before arrival at the convention to be exchanged at the convention. This is not a local dallas flea market, listing items for sale with local pickup as the only option for getting the games is not the purpose of this list. You can certainly offer local pickup but you need to be able to bring your games to bgg con or have someone else do it in order to participate in the BGG Con VFM.
Please include the condition of your item and the price you'd like to sell for. Then you will simply swap the game for payment at the meetup with the buyer.
The in person event is not a sales event simply an exchange of deals made on this geeklist beforehand. Please do not try and set up a sales table (had a person do that in once), if you are looking to set up an in person sales table you are looking for the awesome BGG Bazaar.
If you are having a problem with keeping track of your items subscribe to the items you bid on and are selling. Then you can edit the geeklist settings to turn off comments so you only see comments on things you are subscribed to. Helps keep track of things a lot.
[size=18][u][b]Guidelines[/b][/u][/size]
How you sell your items is up to you! Fixed Price, Auction, Dutch Auction, it doesn't matter. Everyone is on their own - no one will be monitoring your items but you. If you are running an auction, please be sure to define how that auction is going to run, particularly how/when it is going to end [b]NOTE:[/b] please make sure your auction ends before May 16th as it will not count as a sale if it isn't marked sold before the 16th.
The main thing to always keep in mind is to be please be polite. Some buyers will make potentially lowball offers. Some sellers won't be interested in making deals.
[size=18][u][b]Delivery Meetup[/b][/u][/size]
As in the past, we have a reserved time and space at BGG.Con Spring to make the swaps in the Innovation Ballroom on TBD.
[b](room info and times are from 2023 will be updated as soon as i get info)[/b]
Sellers will be allowed to enter starting at 7pm in order to setup. Current plan if for sellers to enter from Innovation D. Sellers will not be admitted after 7:50. If you are unable to obtain a seller's table, you must make other arrangements for swapping your games. If you are not going to be able to be at the swap, [b]you need to note this in the item description[/b]. By participating in the VFM list as a seller and obtaining a seller's table you are agreeing to arrive early to set up. You may bring one helper with you to help out at your table. Sellers are expected to remain at their table until all items are sold. Based on 2023 numbers, there should be enough tables for anyone that sells more than 6 items. If you sell fewer than 6 we might be able to combine some tables but do not expect it. You or your helper are expected to be at your table for the entire duration of the VFM until you do not have anything left to sell.
Buyers are free to line up during this setup time but are not permitted inside yet. If you both buy and sell, you will need someone to pick up or be at your table as again someone must be at your table during the entirety of the VFM do not leave it unattended. Buyers will be able to enter from 8 PM.
[u][size=18][b]PLEASE BE PROMPT![/b][/size][/u] as both a Buyer and as a Seller no one wants to be stuck waiting around until 8:59 with 1 game left to trade or a buyer stuck waiting for a no show seller because you didn't want to leave your game early.
You are, of course, welcome to arrange other times/methods for your swaps on an individual basis (but see the note about an early meetup below).
Team Geek will be present overseeing the meetup. It is expected that all participants will cooperate fully with Team Geek.
[size=18][u][b]Delivery Meetup Room Plan[/b][/u][/size]
In order to facilitate the meetup, tables will be assigned to sellers. Prior to the convention, the room plan will be posted in this header. Tables will be arranged in alphabetical order by user name. Tables will be labelled at the time of the meetup.
[b]If you wish to pair up with someone please send me a geekmail.[/b]
[size=18][u][b]Unsold Game Filter Tools[/b][/u][/size]
What is the sortable list? It's basically a dynamically updating listing of this geek list that lets you sort and filter rather than scroll through listings one by one. This way you can sort on a user, or on a letter, or look for a specific game. In addition you can use the bulk upload tool to list many games at once. As long as they are in your bgg collection and marked for trade it will create a listing for you that you can customize.
[url=https://yulgame.com/Vfm/AddItems/33141]Bulk add games to the geeklist[/url] * This is an easy way to bulk add items to the geeklist, courtesy of Eric Bettan (Carnage994): [url=https://yulgame.com/Vfm/Items/331341]BGG Spring VFM 2024 sortable list[/url] [url=https://sunderedrealm.com/bgg/bgg-list.php?l=331341]Alternate BGG Spring VFM 2024 sortable list[/url] Provided by Dave Rathbun
In order for your games to better show up on this list the way you want to please follow the best practices below.
[u][size=18][b]Listing best practices[/b][/size][/u]
These are some best practices for listing your items in the VFM they help with the listing tools and are just great ways to have people understand your listing. These will be updated with any tool specific requirements.
1. When your item sells, please use your Mark sold button directly below the picture of your game.
2. If your item is an auction, please include the word "Auction" someplace.
4. If you wish to remove an item from the summary list, add +remove+ in the game's entry. This tag takes precedence over everything else.
5. If you are selling an item that needs an alternate name in the summary list, please place this code in your item someplace: "+altname+ Whatever You'd Like To Call Your Item -altname-"
6. [b]Please don't delete sold items!! [/b]Just leave them on the list. Thank you!
7. Please do not mark items as SOLD if they are not actually SOLD
[u][size=18][b]Request List[/b][/size][/u]
If there is something you are looking for add it to the [geeklist=331338]BGG VFM 2024 Request List[/geeklist].
[u][size=18][b]Processing Payments[/b][/size][/u]
Per BGG Guidelines, it is the seller's responsibility to process final sales through the BGG Marketplace. This may be facilitated by use of the sold button below each item's picture. Some people like to do a single lump sum payment for everything or for items where the buyer did not respond to the listing. In the past I have used a listing under Outside the Scope of BGG for this simply add the item on the geekmarket for the amount you need and mark it sold.
[u][size=18][b]Early Meetup[/b][/size][/u]
In the past, some of the participants in the Fall VFM have tried to set up an early meetup on the night before the official start of the convention. This has been discouraged for several years now. While individuals getting together to make trades is certainly appropriate, please do not schedule a large-scale early meetup before the start of the convention.
[b]Please do add your items![/b] The more items, the more interest!
[b]Please do not delete items once added.[/b] If an item is no longer available, please edit it to reflect that, but leave it in place. You can add +remove+ to the entry to keep it off the summary list.
[u][size=18][b]Additional tips for sellers and buyers:[/b][/size][/u]
Sellers:
1. Create a spreadsheet with the games your selling. Create columns for Game Name, Game Cost, Method of Payment, Buyer Name, Buyer BGG Name, Comments, etc. If you're paying via PayPal, Venmo, etc. make a note. Print off your list prior to the event and bring it with you.
2. Send out geek mails and confirm with the game sale with people who have bought games from you. Sometimes people miss responses to game transactions. Run your sales through BGG Marketplace either as a lot or individually so BGG can get their cut. It's only fair.
3. Have a full-length, printed sheet with your BGG User Name, Name, and Avatar/Logo on it for people to find you more easily.
4. Print out the table assignments beforehand. Circle your table.
5. Get there right at 7:00 pm to set up your games and table.
6. You must attend the whole hour or until all your games being sold are picked up by Buyers.
7. Team up with a friend (or a few friends) if you are both Buying and Selling games. You cannot be both a Buyer and Seller at the VFM event.
8. Removable Sticky notes on the game with the name of the Buyer picking up your games would be helpful.
9. Please get your money out of the envelopes and deposit the empty envelopes in the trash. Please do not leave it for staff to clean up!
10. Remember it's the most wonderful game time of the year! Be kind, courteous, and try to help others out as possible. This event is super fun!
Buyers:
1. Create a spreadsheet with the games you're buying. Create columns for Game Name, Game Cost, Method of Payment, Seller Name, Seller BGG Name, Comments, etc. If you're paying via PayPal, Venmo, etc. make a note. Print off your list prior to the event and bring it with you.
2. Buy plain envelopes. Write down the name of each game you're buying and the BGG name of the Seller. Provide exact change. Put your name on your envelopes so it's easily identified as paid by sellers or in case it gets lost.
3. Get there around 7:45 pm and wait in line to get in. Buyers can't go in until 8:00 pm.
4. Bring plenty of bags to haul off your 'new' games. You may not be able to use the luggage carts.
5. Print out the table assignments beforehand. Circle or highlight the tables you need to visit.
6. Remember it's the most wonderful game time of the year! Be kind, courteous, and try to help others out as possible. This event is super fun!
There is a Virtual Flea Market microbadge Microbadge: BGG.CON Virtual Flea Market fan Get one and show your support for the VFM!
Still have questions/comments/concerns? Please comment on this item and people will be glad to help.
(if you want to help answer questions subscribe to this item)

Item: Flash Point: Fire Rescue Bundle Condition: Like New / New Price: $70 +sold+ to [user=GWGumby]
Description A bundle that includes the Flash Point: Fire Rescue Base Game, the Urban Structures Expansion, the 2nd Story Expansion and finally a Broken Token Crate already assembled with game bits sorted and stored. The BT insert alone is $75 brand new and then you have to (or get to, depending on your preference for this sort of thing) assemble it. There is a small divot / chip on the front of the box but other than that it looks fantastic.
Links to all included items: [thing=100901][/thing] [thing=110139][/thing] [thing=126954][/thing] [thing=238246][/thing]
Get the game and the assembled insert for the retail price of the insert alone! This price is on fire! [i](see what I did there...)[/i]

item.comment: Is this all organized into one box? Can you take a photo of the collection and/or components with the insert?

[q="GWGumby"]Is this all organized into one box? Can you take a photo of the collection and/or components with the insert?[/q] Certainly! And yes, all of the expansions are in the Broken Token crate. To be clear, this is [b]not an insert[/b]...this is a replacement wooden box that is designed to hold all of the Flash Point Fire Rescue components and expansions. The crate alone retails for about $80. (It was $75 when I first listed this, which is why that's the number in the listing above.) You can see pictures of the product at the BT web site.
https://thebrokentoken.com/products/game-crate-compatible-with-flash-point-fire-rescue
Please take a look at the BT page and then let me know if you would still like for me to take pictures of the actual item I have. The BT pictures show all of the expansions...I only have the ones listed, but there is room for all of the map packs in the bottom of the box.
Thanks Dave. I just needed to better understand. I'll take this for $70.

[q="GWGumby"]Thanks Dave. I just needed to better understand. I'll take this for $70.[/q] You bet, thanks! And to be clear, I'll take payment only after you've seen / inspected the bundle and it meets your expectations.

Item: Port expansion for Village Condition: NIS Price: $40 +sold+ to [user=otscotty] for $25 plus [listitem=10675817]Deep Space D-6: Armada[/listitem]
Description Delivered one of these on eBay for $50+, have another copy and don't know why I didn't list it here first. Yes, there is a new reprint "big box" edition of this game. But if you have the original game and do not have this expansion, here's your chance! The Port expansion replaces the travel component of the game with a (in my opinion) more interesting shipping option, where you are picking up and dropping off goods, plus there is the opportunity to be buried at sea instead of the village chronicle. $40 is the original retail for this expansion, so it's not marked up despite being out of print / unavailable everywhere.

Item: Prophecy Bundle: Base Game (Open) + Dragon Expansion (NIS) Condition: See below Price: $35 Offers Considered
Description This is another game where I've picked up multiple copies over the years. The base game is in excellent condition; the board is nice and glossy and the cards look like they have barely been played, if at all. There is extremely minimal box wear on the game box. That's the good. When I purchased this copy I did an inventory (as I always do!) and discovered it's missing one "magic" cube. There are 40 red plastic strength cubes but only 39 blue plastic magic cubes. I planned to purchase wooden cubes to replace both the red and blue but before doing that I acquired another copy.
This bundle also includes the [thing=26218]Dragon Realm Expansion[/thing] which is brand new in shrink wrap.

FP means fixed priced, no other offers accepted except the listed price.

the cover is worn

item.comment: I would take this for $10. I'm not familiar with what FP means.

[q="adamxpaul"]I would take this for $10. I'm not familiar with what FP means.[/q] FP = Fixed Price (offers may be considered but the seller is looking for a set amount) Other abbreviations you might encounter would be SB = Starting Bid (starts an auction that will end at some point with the highest bid in the comments taking the prize) BIN = Buy It Now (bypass the auction and go straight to a purchase at some higher amount)
FP and BIN both allow you to claim the item, it's just in a different format (listing versus auction).
Hope this helps! Welcome to the VFM!
Thank you for the help!
SOLD

item.body:
Hanayama Jigsaw 28 Puzzle
[img]https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/v6UAAOSwig1jpHTh/s-l1200.jpg[/img]
There are way too many edge pieces and frustratingly large tabs and blanks in this 28 piece jigsaw brainteaser puzzle! An ingenious twist on the traditional jigsaw puzzle, the Jigsaw 28 is actually a challenging packing puzzle that will have you scratching your head.
Yuu Asaka has created a line of creative packing-style puzzles that have taken the puzzle world by storm. They all share solutions with an absolutely captivating twist, Try it out and see why Yuu's inventive packing puzzles have become a sensation! A fantastic puzzle to share with friends!
There is only one solution. Tray measures 10 cm x 10 cm.
Comes in the solved state inside a plastic ziploc bag with Japanese writing. Designed by Yuu Asaka and produced by Hanayama.

item.comment: I can’t say no. I’d like this for $5. Theme sounds ridiculous

The theme is ridiculous and I really appreciated it hitting my table. It certainly caused some loud yelling realizing someone was overproducing a material that wasn't needed entirely for their own benefit. It has some typography problems where the theme is stronger than the usability, but it's definitely worth taking it for a spin.

Chris, I am deeply deeply disappointed that you forced me to buy this game against my will. I hold you personally responsible it this is the game that finally causes my closet to collapse upon itself into a singularity of shame. 🤣
But, as you stare at the pile of debris that once used to be called your closet, you can bask in the satisfaction of "well, at least I helped a charity...." 😂

I opened up the box and took everything out, and I think I have the core box with the upgrades (plastic coins, plastic clan tokens, extra sculpts, cardboard replacements for some cards), but NOT: KS exclusive minis, Daimyo box, or Dynasty Invasion expansion. Since this version doesn't have as many bells and whistles as I first thought, I am dropping the price to $75.

I found myself thinking of how useful it could be as a gateway game. For what it’s worth, my wife loved the game, though her opinion might have been influenced by her win on the 3rd tiebreaker. Doh!
